comment: Electric easements (5' and 15' marked on site plan) are shown on the site plan. The code absolutely prohibits installing customer facilities under or over Austin Energy overhead distribution facilities, independent of clearance distances. Additionally, items within electric easements must maintain minimum 7.5-foot clearance from outside conductor. Without detailed easement boundary documentation and clearance dimension annotations from conductors, compliance cannot be verified.

comment: Decorative lighting is referenced in the site plan notes (exterior lighting must be full cut-off and fully-shielded per Subchapter E 2.5, reviewed at building plan stage).
